column5: This scholar has written many books.
column6: 学者 is a scholar, a person who does research: 一位学者 (a scholar), 有名的学者 (a famous scholar).

column4: 夏天，孩子们都爱吃雪糕。
column5: In summer, the children all love eating ice lollies.
column6: 雪糕 is an ice lolly, or an ice-cream bar: 一根雪糕 (an ice lolly), 吃雪糕 (to eat an ice lolly).

column4: 如果有问题，可以向老师询问。
column5: If you have a question, you can ask the teacher.
column6: 询问 is to ask for information, a little more formal than 问: 询问价格 (to ask about the price), 向他询问 (to ask him).

column5: He is looking for his phone.
column6: 寻找 is to look for, more formal than 找: 寻找答案 (to look for an answer), 寻找机会 (to look for a chance).

column5: The athletes must train every day.
column6: 训练 is to train, or training: 训练运动员 (to train athletes), 每天的训练 (daily training).

column4: 这个城市发展得很迅速。
column5: This city is developing very rapidly.
column6: 迅速 is rapid and quick, and more formal than 快: 发展迅速 (to develop rapidly), 迅速回答 (to answer at once).

column5: Oh, it is raining!
column6: 呀 at the start of a clause is an exclamation of surprise, read yā: 呀，下雨了！ After a word it is a soft "ya", a gentler 啊: 好呀 (OK!), 快来呀 (come quickly!).

column5: To rent a flat, one must pay a deposit.
column6: 押金 is a deposit that is given back later: 交押金 (to pay a deposit), 退押金 (to return a deposit).

column4: 过年的时候，爷爷给了我压岁钱。
column5: At the New Year, my grandfather gave me New Year money.
column6: 压岁钱 is the money that elders give to children at the Chinese New Year: 给压岁钱 (to give New Year money), 拿压岁钱 (to receive it).

column5: There are a few ducks in the river.
column6: 鸭子 is a duck: 一只鸭子 (a duck), 小鸭子 (a duckling).

column5: His teeth are very white.
column6: 牙齿 are the teeth, a little more formal than 牙: 一颗牙齿 (a tooth), 保护牙齿 (to protect the teeth).

column5: He walks slowly along the river bank.
column6: 沿 is "along": 沿河 (along the river), 沿路 (along the road), 沿着 + place (along a place).

column4: 学校延长了图书馆的开门时间。
column5: The school extended the library's opening hours.
column6: 延长 is to make something longer in time: 延长时间 (to extend the time), 延长假期 (to extend a holiday).

column4: 这家公司在研发新手机。
column5: This company is developing a new phone.
column6: 研发 is to research and develop a product: 研发新产品 (to develop a new product), 研发费用 (research and development costs).

column5: The teacher's expression is very serious.
column6: 严肃 is serious in look, tone or matter: 表情严肃 (a serious expression), 严肃的问题 (a serious matter). Compare 认真, which is "careful and serious about doing something".

column4: 科学家研制了一种新药。
column5: The scientists developed a new medicine.
column6: 研制 is to develop something new through research: 研制新药 (to develop a new medicine), 研制汽车 (to develop cars). Compare 研发.

column5: He glanced at me.
column6: 眼 is the eye, as in 眼睛, and it counts glances: 看一眼 (to take a look), 一眼 (a glance), 眼泪 (tears).

column3: to give a speech; a speech
column5: He will give a speech at school tomorrow.
column6: 演讲 is to give a speech, or a speech: 做演讲 (to give a speech), 演讲比赛 (a speech contest).

column5: Tears ran down her face.
column6: 眼泪 is tears: 流眼泪 (to shed tears), 擦眼泪 (to wipe away tears).

column5: The balcony of my home is very big.
column6: 阳台 is a balcony: 阳台上 (on the balcony), 一个阳台 (a balcony).

column5: The style of this clothing is very new.
column6: 样式 is a style or a design: 新样式 (a new style), 样式很多 (many styles).

column5: His lower back hurts a little.
column6: 腰 is the waist or the lower back: 腰疼 (a sore lower back), 弯腰 (to bend over).

column5: He shook his head.
column6: 摇 is to shake or wave something: 摇头 (to shake one's head), 摇手 (to wave a hand), 摇尾巴 (to wag a tail).

column5: The puppy bit him.
column6: 咬 is to bite: 咬人 (to bite people), 咬了一下 (to bite once), 别咬 (do not bite).

column4: 我们快走吧，要不会迟到。
column5: Let us hurry up, or else we will be late.
column6: 要不 means "or else", and also suggests another option: 要不就… (or else …), 要不我们明天再去？ (how about we go again tomorrow?).

column4: 要不是你帮我，我今天就迟到了。
column5: If you had not helped me, I would have been late today.
column6: 要不是 means "if it were not for": 要不是你 (if it were not for you), 要不是下雨 (if it were not for the rain).

column5: This shop sells all kinds of medicines.
column6: 药品 is medicine as a product that is sold: 一种药品 (a kind of medicine), 买药品 (to buy medicine).

column4: 这种药物对感冒很有用。
column5: This medicine is very useful for colds.
column6: 药物 is medicine in a medical sense: 治疗药物 (a medicine for treatment), 药物的影响 (the effect of a medicine). 药 is the everyday word.

column5: One must be careful when driving at night.
column6: 夜间 is "at night", a little formal: 夜间开车 (to drive at night), 夜间气温 (the night temperature). 晚上 is the everyday word.

column4: 周末我们去夜市吃东西。
column5: At the weekend we go to the night market to eat.
column6: 夜市 is a night market: 去夜市 (to go to the night market), 夜市小吃 (night-market snacks).

column4: 他对公司的业务很熟悉。
column5: He is very familiar with the company's business.
column6: 业务 is the work or business of a company or a person: 公司业务 (company business), 业务很忙 (busy with work).

column5: His spare-time hobby is painting.
column6: 业余 is outside of work, or amateur: 业余时间 (spare time), 业余爱好 (a hobby), 业余歌手 (an amateur singer).

column5: What is the basis for this decision?
column6: 依据 is a basis, or "according to": 依据事实 (based on the facts), 没有依据 (no basis).

column4: 孩子不能总是依靠父母。
column5: Children cannot always rely on their parents.
column6: 依靠 is to rely on: 依靠自己 (to rely on oneself), 依靠别人 (to rely on others).

column4: 这个地方的医疗条件很好。
column5: The medical facilities in this place are good.
column6: 医疗 is medical care: 医疗服务 (medical services), 医疗水平 (the level of medical care).

column4: 他依然像以前一样热情。
column5: He is still as friendly as before.
column6: 依然 is "still, as before", more formal than 还: 依然很好 (still good), 依然如此 (still like this).

column5: He studies medicine at university.
column6: 医学 is the science of medicine: 学医学 (to study medicine), 医学知识 (medical knowledge).

column5: Please move the chair over there.
column6: 移 is to move something a short way: 移开 (to move away), 移到 (to move to).

column5: This is a disposable cup.
column6: 一次性 is "used once, one-time": 一次性筷子 (disposable chopsticks), 一次性付钱 (to pay all at once).

column5: The new generation is very clever.
column6: 一代 is a generation: 年轻的一代 (the young generation), 这一代人 (this generation).

column5: Once you start, do not stop.
column6: 一旦 is "once, if ever", for something that may happen: 一旦开始 (once it starts), 一旦有问题 (if a problem comes up).

column5: He moved the table a little.
column6: 移动 is to move, or mobile: 移动电话 (a mobile phone), 请不要移动 (please do not move it).

column4: 不能和你一起去，我觉得很遗憾。
column5: I feel it is a pity that I cannot go with you.
column6: 遗憾 is a regret, or a pity: 很遗憾 (a great pity), 感到遗憾 (to feel regret), 一个遗憾 (a regret).

column3: all the way; the whole journey
column4: 一路上，孩子们都在唱歌。
column5: The children are singing all the way.
column6: 一路 is the whole way of a journey: 一路上 (all the way), 一路平安 (have a safe trip).

column5: Have a good trip!
column6: 一路顺风 is a set phrase for wishing someone a good trip: 祝你一路顺风 (have a good trip). Literally it is "all the way, a smooth wind".

column5: If you have any questions, please tell me.
column6: 疑问 is a doubt or a question about something unclear: 有疑问 (to have a question), 没有疑问 (no doubt).

column5: Everyone's opinions are very consistent.
column6: 一致 is the same or in agreement: 意见一致 (to agree), 一致同意 (to agree unanimously).

column5: I am in Class B, and he is in Class A.
column6: 乙 is the second of a list, like B after A: 甲乙 (A and B), 乙班 (Class B), 乙组 (Group B).

column4: 他以优秀的成绩毕业了。
column5: He graduated with excellent results.
column6: 以 is a formal "by, with, as": 以…的成绩 (with … results), 以朋友的身份 (as a friend), 以…为骄傲 (to be proud of …). It is also in 以前, 以后 and 可以.

column4: 我买了苹果、香蕉以及牛奶。
column5: I bought apples, bananas as well as milk.
column6: 以及 is "as well as", used in writing to join things: A、B 以及 C (A, B as well as C).

column4: 来中国以来，我学了很多汉语。
column5: Since coming to China, I have learned a lot of Chinese.
column6: 以来 is "since", placed after the time: 来中国以来 (since coming to China), 今年以来 (since the start of this year).

column5: This number is one hundred million.
column6: 亿 is 100,000,000: 一亿 (a hundred million), 十亿 (a billion).

column4: 他没有意识到问题的严重。
column5: He did not realise how serious the problem was.
column6: 意识 is to realise, or awareness: 意识到 (to realise), 安全意识 (safety awareness).

column5: This result is very unexpected.
column6: 意外 is unexpected, or an unexpected accident: 很意外 (very unexpected), 发生意外 (to have an accident).

column4: 红灯意味着车要停下来。
column5: A red light means that cars must stop.
column6: 意味着 is "to mean, to imply", for results and signs: 意味着什么 (what does it mean?), 这意味着 (this means that …). 意思 is the meaning of words.

column4: 每个人都有保护环境的义务。
column5: Everyone has a duty to protect the environment.
column6: 义务 is a duty, or free and voluntary: 有义务 (to have a duty), 义务工作 (voluntary work).

column5: This matter is very meaningful.
column6: 意义 is meaning or significance: 有意义 (meaningful), 没有意义 (meaningless), 意义很大 (very significant). 意思 is the meaning of a word; 意义 is the value or importance.

column4: 他很努力，因而进步很快。
column5: He works very hard, and therefore makes fast progress.
column6: 因而 is "therefore", used in writing after a reason: 因为…，因而… (because …, therefore …).

column5: The volume of this phone is very loud.
column6: 音量 is the volume of a sound: 音量大 (loud), 放小音量 (to turn the volume down).

column4: 天气是一个重要的因素。
column5: The weather is an important factor.
column6: 因素 is a factor: 重要因素 (an important factor), 很多因素 (many factors).

column4: 这家公司引进了新技术。
column5: This company has introduced new technology.
column6: 引进 is to bring in from outside: 引进技术 (to introduce technology), 从国外引进 (to bring in from abroad).

column5: A healthy diet is very important.
column6: 饮食 is food and drink, or a diet: 健康饮食 (a healthy diet), 饮食习惯 (eating habits).

column5: This book is very well printed.
column6: 印刷 is to print books and papers with a press: 印刷书 (to print books). 打印 is to print from a computer.

column5: Students should study hard.
column6: 应当 is "ought to, should", a little more formal than 应该: 应当努力 (should work hard), 应当帮助别人 (should help others).

column5: We welcome the New Year together.
column6: 迎 is to welcome or go and meet someone: 迎新年 (to welcome the New Year), 迎客人 (to welcome guests).

column4: 同学们到门口迎接新老师。
column5: The students go to the door to welcome the new teacher.
column6: 迎接 is to welcome in person: 迎接客人 (to welcome guests), 迎接新年 (to welcome the new year).

column5: There is a lot of nutrition in milk.
column6: 营养 is nutrition: 有营养 (nutritious), 营养丰富 (rich in nutrition).

column4: 这家商店九点开始营业。
column5: This shop opens for business at nine o'clock.
column6: 营业 is to be open for business: 营业时间 (opening hours), 开始营业 (to open for business).

column5: This film is very moving.
column6: 影片 is a film as a work: 一部影片 (a film), 看影片 (to watch a film).

column4: 他想做影视方面的工作。
column5: He wants to do work in film and TV.
column6: 影视 is film and television together: 影视明星 (a film and TV star), 影视工作 (work in film and TV).

column5: This bread is too hard.
column6: 硬 is hard, not soft: 很硬 (very hard), 硬床 (a hard bed). The opposite is 软.

column3: to deal with; to cope with
column5: We must learn to deal with difficulties.
column6: 应对 is to deal with a situation: 应对困难 (to deal with difficulties), 应对问题 (to handle a problem).

column5: The hardware of this computer is very good.
column6: 硬件 is hardware: 电脑硬件 (computer hardware). The opposite is 软件. It can also mean facilities: 学校的硬件 (the school's facilities).

column4: 这个办法可以应用在很多地方。
column5: This method can be applied in many places.
column6: 应用 is to apply or use, and also "application" or an app: 应用知识 (to apply knowledge), 手机应用 (a phone app).

column4: 见到妈妈，他高兴地拥抱了她。
column5: Seeing his mother, he happily hugged her.
column6: 拥抱 is to hug, or a hug: 拥抱朋友 (to hug a friend), 一个拥抱 (a hug).

column5: He owns a small company.
column6: 拥有 is to own or possess, more formal than 有: 拥有一家公司 (to own a company), 拥有很多朋友 (to have many friends).
